findings.expected: One snapshot per confirmed save; the dialog closes on success and a confirmation toast names the new snapshot.
findings.observed: Four snapshots exist — api.dataset_versions now holds four rows for dataset 9872c1b4-… (created_at 19:36:26.789, 19:36:35.003, 19:36:52.491, 19:37:xx), all labelled 'Fixture Owner · saved by hand', each with source_dataset_revision 1. The tab count went 'Snapshots 0' → 'Snapshots 4' behind the modal while the dialog was still open. No toast/role=alert appeared after the POST (POST /api/db/rpc/snapshot_dataset → 200 each time) and the label field was re-prefilled with 'Fixture Owner · saved by hand'. Clicking Save again after that produced the label 'Fixture Owner · saved by handQA2 probe snapshot'. Only 'Cancel' removed the dialog.
findings.repro: 1. Open a dataset you own → Snapshots → 'Create snapshot'. 2. Click 'Save snapshot' with the Label field empty. 3. The snapshot is saved (poll api.dataset_versions / the row count behind the modal) but the dialog stays open with no message. 4. Click 'Save snapshot' again — a second, identical snapshot is created.
findings.evidence: Four api.dataset_versions rows for 9872c1b4-ee40-43cc-91ba-3d4ae6eb025c after four Save clicks; 'Snapshots 4' in the tab; dialog innerText ('Create snapshot … Label * … Cancel Save snapshot') still present after each save; role=alert/status empty; POST /api/db/rpc/snapshot_dataset 200 (captured in tab.requests()). Note: the source's onSuccess does call setDialogOpen(false) and toast(…), so the observed behaviour disagrees with the code path.

findings.outcome_proof: Live, in a tab with requestAnimationFrame disabled (the exact condition that reproduced the finding): after one click on Save snapshot the DOM went to document.querySelectorAll('[role=dialog]').length === 0, the tab count went Snapshots 9 -> 10, and the second attempt returned 'no save control left' with the count unchanged at 10. Test 'creates a manual snapshot with the entered label and reports success' (src/routes/datasets/$datasetId/snapshots.test.tsx:219-220) asserts snapshotDataset was called exactly once and screen.queryByRole('dialog') is null after success; failure path still keeps the dialog open and toasts 'Could not save the snapshot / stale Dataset revision' (observed live with the dataset revision bumped).

At 15-21 s after load, no element on the page carried a React key (`Object.keys(button).filter(k => k.startsWith('__react'))` = [], same for `document.body`), i.e. React never attached: `main` was still the server-rendered Suspense fallback `Loading your home…`, `Open navigation` had no `aria-expanded` change, `Switch workspace` stayed `aria-expanded="false"` with 0 `[role="menu"]` nodes, and clicking `New` left `aria-expanded="false"` with 0 `[role="menu"]` nodes. Leading explanation is a width-dependent hydration failure at md (768-1023 px), but the shared dev server was degraded by concurrent sweeps late in the run so this is not 100% excluded.
